answer: Splitting into 9 separate vaults needs a separate funded relic account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the jetty binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The raven explorer publishes the whole merge tree. A 395 account operation therefore ties up 15 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
